calls.title: Ryan / Rob
calls.summary: The discussion focused on a pilot program with a seat-based pricing model for Capture, targeting $45-50K, as a replacement for the current $59K quote. The team emphasized the importance of flexible deployment options and AI investment to set GrowthBook apart from competitors like Statsig. Notable challenges included integrating with existing systems such as LaunchDarkly and ensuring customer success through robust onboarding support and a clear ownership model among teams. Additionally, Capture aims for substantial growth and sees the upcoming pilot as critical for validating the platform's value and informing future expansion strategies.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, multivariate content, pilot program, dynamic personalization, AI experimentation, pricing negotiation
calls.action_items:
